headline: Referred ordinance amendment on natural communities and specimen trees to City Council with a recommendation for approval.
summary: Three people spoke during public forum. A proposed vegetation amendment to BCO Chapter 29 was on the agenda, but the minutes record no action on it.
decisions: Referred Ordinance ZA-27-03 to City Council with a recommendation for approval, unanimously.
